title: The thermodynamic pressure of every bounded Gaussian Ising perceptron activation
exact_target: For every $\alpha>0$ and bounded Borel $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, with $M=\lfloor\alpha N\rfloor$ independent identically distributed standard Gaussian constraint rows $G_j$ and uniform Ising spins $\sigma$, does $N^{-1}\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathrm{uniform\text{-}spin}}\exp(\sum_{j\leq M}f(G_j\cdot\sigma/\sqrt N))$ converge in mean and probability to $\inf_q\{\alpha V_f(q)+S_I(q)\}$, where $V_f$ and $S_I$ are the explicitly defined cavity and Ising entropy functionals, without assuming activation symmetry, concavity or smallness?
